description:
Operating Area: India

Boarding Point: Britona Jetty (Panjim).

Luxury Catamaran is a 50 foot yacht, spacious, luxurious and well maintained.
It can hold a capacity of 25 guests on board, it has different levels of decks, front deck, rear deck and upper deck.
All the decks have seating capacity where guests can be scattered around so they can enjoy the scenic view of the goa waters. The AC cabin inside has dinning facility along with sofas and can accommodate 15 to 17 guests at a time comfortably. 
Catamaran is a yacht that is made up with two different hulls thereby increasing the strength on the boat and making it very sturdy in all kinds of weather conditions.
Catamaran will set you for a Sail on the high Arabian seas hopping lovely beaches taking you on a ride along the beautiful backwaters of Goa or you make you groove right in the middle of the sea.
The catamaran provides 2 cabinets fully tarnished with Wi-Fi facility, music system with Bluetooth and mobile charging facilities.
Fully equipped kitchen with heating facility oven, fridge, crockery, cutlery and glasses for guests on board. Experience a bungee cot for fun on board, Rest and relaxation on board with live barbeques. One can celebrate several occasions such as birthdays, anniversaries, corporate dinners or team building events, engagements, couple dinners and some quality time with close friends and family with breath-taking views, delicious meals and drinks, in a peaceful atmosphere with lots of calmness and close to nature along with a luxurious feeling of the yacht.
Dine in the middle of the enchanting Arabian Sea under the moonlight in Goa. An ideal 2 hour long boat for romantic moments for two for candle light dinners can be organised with prior intimation, live barbeque on the yacht is an experience of a life time. Photo-shoots for pre wedding films or music videos are very popular on the yacht.
Activites such as swimming from the yachts into the river, snorkelling and fishing is also possible with prior bookings no additional cost on that.
Crocodile watching is best done between 10 A.M. to 2 P.M.
The boat has all safety features like life jackets, tubes, ropes, life guard on board along with a certified captain along with the crew.
The price includes one hour cruising and one hour anchorage.
